# Agent-browser Eve extension

`agent-browser-eve-0.37.1-eve.0.52.5.tgz` rebuilds the official extension from
[agent-browser v0.37.1](https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-browser/tree/72007a6788d863611b23bed0b59d0d659c638d8e/packages/@agent-browser/eve)
with our installed Eve 0.52.5 compiler. Extension tools are unchanged. Apache-2.0
LICENSE is included.

The published 0.37.1 package was built with Eve 0.47.3 and declares tool contract
21. Eve 0.52.5 dropped that contract. Its diagnostic is obscured by a subsequent
“Selected module binding … has no compile or runtime usage” error. Upgrading to
0.54.3 reproduced the rejection; the application remains on 0.52.5.

Reproduce in an isolated directory:

1. Download the source archive at commit `72007a6788d863611b23bed0b59d0d659c638d8e`.
2. Copy `packages/@agent-browser/eve` and the repository `LICENSE` into the build
   directory. Set package version to `0.37.1-eve.0.52.5`, replace its
   `@agent-browser/sandbox` workspace dependency with `0.37.1`, pin its Eve build
   dependency to `0.52.5`, and remove the workspace-only `prepare` script.
3. Install dependencies without lifecycle scripts, using TypeScript 5.9.0,
   zod 4.4.3 and Node 24. Run `eve extension build`, then
   `tsc -p tsconfig.sandbox.json`.
4. Run `npm pack --ignore-scripts` and copy the tarball here. Update the pnpm
   lockfile through `pnpm install` and build all three roots.

The compatibility manifest is generated by the compiler, never edited to bypass
validation. Each root mounts the extension separately; browser sessions are
sandbox-derived, with no shared cookie or browser state. Reviewer navigation is
restricted to locally prepared candidate servers. A successful build proves
packaging compatibility; browser functionality still needs a sandbox run.
